extras: Local-first tool; currently in Alpha development; requires Node.js >= 20.19.0 for web version.
intentEvidence: Excalicap 把 Excalidraw 的自由绘图、以 Frame 组织的多页 Slide、摄像头、麦克风、光标和提词器放进同一套工作流
motivation: To help creators move from content design directly to high-definition video output.
problem: Creators face complexity when moving from initial content design to producing high-definition video content using tools like Excalidraw.
summary: Whiteboard video creation and recording tool that integrates Excalidraw drawing, slide organization, and multimedia capture into a single workflow for high-definition video output.
